priorStories.headline: Three states carry out executions in one day
priorStories.body:
Florida, Alabama and Indiana each carried out a lethal-injection execution Thursday.

Florida executed Jesse Guardado for the 2004 murder of Jackie Malone. Alabama executed Michael Taylor for killing Ivan and Lucille Moore in 1991. Indiana executed Jeffrey Weisheit shortly after midnight for killing two children in a 2010 house fire.

Guardado’s death was Florida’s 19th execution this year, tying the state’s annual record.

priorStories.headline: S&P 500 falls 4.4% in AI-led sell-off
priorStories.body:
The S&P 500 fell 4.4% Thursday, its largest one-day decline since April 2025. The Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 1,833 points, or 3.4%, and the Nasdaq fell 5.5%.

Companies associated with artificial-intelligence data centers led the sell-off, which erased the previous day’s gains. The Nasdaq ended in correction territory relative to its October high.

candidates.summary: Japan’s Nikkei 225 and South Korea’s Kospi each closed 6% lower Friday as the previous day’s AI-led Wall Street sell-off spread globally. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng fell 1.3%, mainland China’s Shanghai Composite lost 1.1%, and major European indexes opened lower.
candidates.title: AI-led market sell-off spreads to Asia and Europe

candidates.summary: Myanmar’s Union Election Commission announced that special elections will be held April 4, 2027, to fill vacancies in 55 constituencies. The vote will include areas where armed conflicts continue and towns recently recaptured by the military.
candidates.title: Myanmar schedules April parliamentary by-elections

candidates.summary: Interim results from South Africa’s local elections showed the African National Congress headed for a substantial decline in support and possible loss of control in major cities. The MK Party, founded by former president Jacob Zuma, was leading in the eThekwini municipality, which includes Durban, as counting continued.
candidates.title: South Africa election count points to major ANC losses
